discount_df['Month'] = pd.to_datetime(discount_df['Month'])

# Group by month and sum
monthly_discount = discount_df.groupby('Month')['Total'].sum().reset_index()
monthly_discount = monthly_discount.sort_values('Month')

# Read SUMMARY sheet
summary_df = pd.read_excel(spreadsheet_path, sheet_name='SUMMARY')

# Load workbook with openpyxl to write to specific cells
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
